This site explores NCAA Division I men's wrestling team performance and championship trends.

The project brings together team standings, championship points, and historical results to make it easier to compare programs across seasons.

## Purpose

The goal is to provide a clear, visual summary of which programs have dominated the sport, how the rankings have shifted over time, and what story the data tells about national wrestling power.

## Data sources

Data sources for team scores and tournament brackets:

- [NCAA Division I Records (D1.pdf)](https://s3.amazonaws.com/fs.ncaa.org/Docs/stats/wrestling_champs_records/D1.pdf)
- [NCAA Division II Records (D2.pdf)](https://s3.amazonaws.com/fs.ncaa.org/Docs/stats/wrestling_champs_records/D2.pdf)
- [NCAA Division III Records (D3.pdf)](https://s3.amazonaws.com/fs.ncaa.org/Docs/stats/wrestling_champs_records/D3.pdf)
- Official tournament brackets and NCAA championship history archives.

## Project scope

The analysis focuses on men’s NCAA wrestling team totals and historical results, with emphasis on how results evolve across different seasons and teams.
